Harry Styles wraps up his Madison Square Garden residency this weekend with his annual “Harryween” celebration on Oct. 31.
Officially the “Harryween Fancy Dress Party,” the one-night-only event invites fans to dress up in costume to attend the singer’s concert, which will mark the last night of his 30-date stop in New York.
Tickets to Harryween 2026 are sold out on Ticketmaster , though it’s worth checking back before the show in case new seats are released. If you want to lock in your seats now, there are a number of tickets available on third-party marketplaces, with some offering special discount codes to save you a few bucks on Styles stubs. StubHub has resale tickets from $850 for section 400 seats as of this writing. The site offers “all in” pricing, so you see the total price up front, with all taxes and fees included. Search for Harryween tickets by price, section, view and “perks” like VIP access or food and drink packages.
StubHub’s FanProtect Guarantee also ensures valid tickets delivered in time for your event or your money back. If the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% of your ticket price as site credit or be given the option of a full refund.
Vivid Seats has Harryween 2026 tickets online from $757 but you can save $30 off your purchase with promo code VR30 . You may be able to score an additional discount when you sign up for the Vivid Seats email list, which offers a 10% promo code for first time purchases.
Buying group tickets? Vivid Seats’ rewards program gets you your eleventh ticket free (in the form of a site credit) after you purchase ten tickets online.
You can also find Harry Styles Harryween tickets online through SeatGeek, with pricing starting from $852 as of this writing. Score a $10 discount with promo code VARIETY10 at checkout. Like StubHub and Vivid Seats, SeatGeek guarantees authentic tickets or your money back. You can also get last-minute tickets delivered by text or email, ensuring you have them on hand in time for the Halloween show.
Of course, the main appeal of Styles’ Harryween concerts is the ability to show up in costume, and the “Aperture” singer has memorably dressed up as everyone from Dorothy from “The Wizard of Oz” to John Travolta in “Grease” at previous Halloween shows.
Costumes are permitted at Saturday’s show with some exceptions. According to Ticketmaster , full-face coverings are permitted only after clearing security and must be removed if requested by security. Large costumes or headpieces, as well as full face paint, fake weapons, and any other “hazardous or distracting item determined at the sole discretion of our security personnel” are not permitted.
Still looking for a last-minute costume? Amazon has a few easy ideas that will arrive in time for Saturday night’s show.
Showtime for Harry Styles’ 2026 Harryween concert is set for 8 p.m. with Jamie XX as the opening act. Styles recently announced that his “Together Together” tour will continue on through 2027 , hitting six cities in North America in April and May, before moving to Europe in July and August.
